name_reason: Fully compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. 'chapter_event_handler' is the correct domain. The '41' is dispatch idx 0x41 (entry 65 in the per-event handler table @ 0x51B91; xref to this fn comes from table entry @ 0x51C95, and (0x51C95-0x51B91)/4 = 0x41) -- a meaningful domain ID, NOT a Ghidra address residue (fn address 0x3599b is unrelated). Same numbering convention as all sibling handlers (handler_2f.._43) in this file. '__shared' is semantically accurate: this single handler backs two chapters' dispatch hooks -- ch27 turn-event slot 1 (turn=0xFF sentinel) and ch28 tile-step event_type 0x00 -- so it is intentionally not chapter-specific. 'dyn_turn_event' is accurate: it arms a dynamic turn-event by writing the turn counter into the turn-event hook table. No address residue. Keep.
purpose: First-time turn-event scheduler shared by chapter 27's turn-event sentinel slot and chapter 28's tile-step: on first hit it arms a dynamic turn-event for the CURRENT turn (no +1) then locks out its own slot.
logic_summary: Dispatched via per-event handler table @ 0x51B91 at idx 0x41 (entry @ 0x51C95). 1-arg cdecl ABI (event_arg unused). PUSH 4 / CALL __CHK (0x36cd7) stack-frame probe. If tile_event_consumed_flags[0x10] == 0 (MOV EAX,[0x53ad5]; CMP byte [EAX+0x10],0): store (byte) data_fd2_battle_turn_counter (MOV DL,byte [0x53bef]) into tile_event_data_table[+3] (MOV EAX,[0x53a55]; MOV byte [EAX+3],DL) -- hook entry 0's turn byte, arming a turn-event at the current turn with NO increment (distinct from handler_3E which writes turn_counter+1) -- then set the consume flag tile_event_consumed_flags[0x10] = 1. Return. Byte read + byte store reproduce the exact 8-bit move.
